newsitem.title: JAPAN: Japan Energy to boost sales of electronic parts.
newsitem.headline: Japan Energy to boost sales of electronic parts.

text.p: Japan Energy Corp said on Tuesday it would strengthen its electronic components division and boost sales of electronic parts as the sector is more profitable than the firm's core oil refining business.
"The market for electronic components is growing and profitability is higher than in petroleum (business)," a Japan Energy spokesman said.
Japan Energy said it hopes to increase sales of electronic components by 2.5 times to 100 billion yen by the year ending March 31, 2001.
The firm's sales of electronic components stood at 38.6 billion yen in the year ended March 1997, less than three percent of its total sales.
The company said it would increase production of thin-film components and copper foil worldwide to achieve its target.
The sales-to-operating profit ratio at Japan Energy's electronic components division is about 10 percent, compared with the company's overall profit ratio of 0.4 percent.
